Anika Patel: Quick heads up — new hire Lina Morales (starts 2026-04-12, fully remote). Visa status: H-4 EAD currently expiring 2026-04-05; candidate says renewal was filed and she has a USCIS receipt number, but she also reported she recently updated her USCIS mailing address (pending). Samir asked whether we can onboard her on 4/12 without blocking product work. What docs do we need and who owns courier/I-9 scheduling?
Samir Gupta: Ideally she starts 4/12. Can be part-time until paperwork clears. Who's coordinating I-9/e-verify? Will she need to come to an office?
Priya Rao: I can own onboarding. Need candidate full name, DOB, receipt number, and scanned copies. But note: for I-9 Section 2 we need to inspect ORIGINAL documents within 3 business days of start. For remote hires we either: (a) schedule an in-person verification at nearest office or (b) use our authorized agent process (courier + agent) — will check availability.
Anika Patel: Receipt #: MSC2345678901, DOB 1994-09-02. Candidate lives in Denver; nearest office is SF (not ideal). She asked if notarized scans would work — answered below.
Nina (Legal): Short version: we cannot accept notarized copies for I-9 Section 2. We need either original docs physically inspected by our authorized agent or candidate to visit an office/sentinel verifier. Regarding EAD: if prior EAD is expired but a timely and properly filed renewal receipt exists, USCIS permits continuity of employment for EAD renewals under certain categories — but this is nuanced. Ask candidate to upload (1) current/previous EAD front/back, (2) USCIS receipt notice for renewal, (3) passport/visa + I-94 showing admission stamp. If receipt shows timely-filed renewal and prior EAD was unexpired at filing, plus receipt valid, we can provisionally onboard but must tie to payroll/immigration review. I'll confirm exact docs once we have scans.
ImmigrationBot: Checklist: https://redwood-internal.docs/immigration/checklists#remote-i9 (candidate-friendly link). Recommended docs: `EAD (front/back)`, `USCIS receipt (I-797C)`, `passport photo page`, `I-94`, `utility bill or lease (address)`.
HR Systems Bot: FYI: To schedule remote Section 2 inspection, submit `#onboarding-authorized-agent` request with candidate name + preferred 3 dates. Agent fee may apply (~$75). Link: https://redwood-internal.tools/onboarding/agent-request
Priya Rao: I'll request agent for week of 4/6 as backup. Also asking candidate if she can travel to SF office week of 4/12. If not, agent route.
Samir Gupta: If we can provisionally onboard (limited access) that's fine. Security team — ok to gate access until clearance? (cc @SecurityOps)
Anika Patel: Candidate asked about USCIS address change — she moved last month and filed form AR-11. Nina, does pending address update affect receipt validity?
Nina (Legal): Usually AR-11 doesn't invalidate receipts. But ask candidate to confirm the receipt mailing address matches what USCIS shows. If there are any return mail issues, candidate should provide digital copies of notices. We'll accept a PDF of the online USCIS account screenshot + receipt if originals are delayed.
Priya Rao: Candidate uploaded initial PDFs to our secure intake form: `EAD_scan.pdf`, `I797C_receipt.pdf`, `passport.pdf`, `I94.png`. I will validate names/dates and then book agent.
Anika Patel: Thanks. Action items: Priya to confirm agent booking or SF visit by 4/3; Nina to confirm whether provisional onboarding allowed given receipt docs; Samir to confirm access gating; candidate to confirm she can travel if needed.
Nina (Legal): I'll review uploads by end of day 4/1. If anything missing, will post exact missing fields.
HR Systems Bot: Reminder: if we provisionally onboard, create ticket `HR-ONB-<candidate>-PROV` and set expiration reminder aligned with EAD adjudication date.
Samir Gupta: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
Anika Patel: Great — I'll update Lina and aim for minimal delay. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
